# MakeTransformations with C#'s needsTransformerForType: non-nullable
# unions, enums, constrained numbers and strings, integer-/bool-strings and
# arrays of those get transformations.
builder prov stm=date:date-time,time:date-time,date-time,uuid,uri,integer-string,bool-string
prim i integer
prim d double
str s unrestricted
prim nul null
prim b bool
prim is integer-string n=IntString
prim bs bool-string
prim dt date-time
enum e red,green n=Color
prim ri integer mm=1:10 n=Ranged
str ls unrestricted ml=2:5 n=Short
union nullable i,nul n=NullableInt
union nullable2 ri,nul n=NullableRanged
union mixed i,s,nul,b n=Mixed
union strs is,e,dt,ls n=Strings
arr arr is
arr arr2 i
cls c x:i n=C
union withclass c,is,d n=WithClass
cls top a:i,b:s,c:is,d:bs,e:e,f:ri,g:ls,h:nullable,h2:nullable2,m:mixed,s:strs,arr:arr,arr2:arr2,w:withclass n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
maketx csharp debug
gc
print
xf 1
xf 2
xf 4
xf 9
xf 11
xf 13
xf 15
xf 20
xf 22
xf 25
